firm_data.firm_description: The Queens District Attorney's Office is a law enforcement agency in Queens, New York, led by District Attorney Melinda Katz. It is dedicated to fairness, public safety, and equal justice for the diverse communities of Queens.
notable_facts: Melinda Katz is the first woman elected as Queens County District Attorney.
The office employs 454 people and has an annual revenue of $19.6 million.

additional_contacts.name: Theresa Shanahan
additional_contacts.title: Executive Assistant District Attorney for the Criminal Practice and Policy Division

email.subject: AI for Queens DA — built for law enforcement tech leaders
email.body:
Hi Charles,

With 454 staff managing Queens' most complex criminal cases, your office faces technology demands that rival BigLaw firms—but with public sector constraints. We've been tracking how DA offices like yours are modernizing case management and evidence handling.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for lean legal teams that need enterprise-grade capabilities. We recently raised $5M, and offices across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us because we understand the specific reality of public defenders and prosecutors: precision, chain-of-custody integrity, and efficiency under pressure.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional law enforcement technology leaders. I'd be happy to visit your office to show how we're helping similar organizations compete with commercial legal tech vendors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
